title: Protect the life of your shingles.
intro: Timberline HDZ shingles do their best work as part of a complete roof. These companion products help protect the edges, deck and roof joints, while balanced ventilation helps manage attic heat and moisture.

items.name: GAF Pro-Start starter strip shingles
items.location: Along the eaves and rake edges
items.benefit: A properly placed adhesive starter course helps secure the first shingle course at wind-vulnerable roof edges.
items.longevity: Helps reduce edge lift and blow-off risk, protecting the rows of shingles above it.
items.selection: Follow Timberline HDZ and starter-strip instructions for fastening, joint offsets and edge details.

items.name: GAF Deck-Armor roof deck protection
items.location: Between the roof deck and field shingles
items.benefit: Breathable underlayment adds a secondary layer against wind-driven rain and helps reduce trapped moisture.
items.longevity: Helps protect the supporting roof deck from moisture damage so the shingles have a sound foundation.
items.selection: Water resistant, not waterproof; underlayment does not replace leak barriers or attic ventilation.

items.name: GAF StormGuard leak barrier
items.location: At eaves, valleys and other specified leak-prone details
items.benefit: A self-adhering barrier helps resist water intrusion from wind-driven rain and ice-dam backup.
items.longevity: Helps protect the deck and interior when water backs up beneath the shingle surface.
items.selection: A leak barrier helps manage water intrusion; it does not stop ice dams from forming. Placement depends on roof details and local requirements.

items.name: GAF Cobra SnowCountry Advanced ridge vent
items.location: At the ridge, paired with sufficient intake ventilation
items.benefit: An exhaust vent works with intake vents to let attic air circulate and help manage heat and moisture.
items.longevity: Balanced airflow helps reduce conditions that can contribute to moisture damage and premature roof-system deterioration.
items.selection: For suitable vented attic designs. Ridge exhaust needs correctly sized, unobstructed intake; adding exhaust alone is not a complete ventilation plan.

items.name: GAF TimberTex ridge cap shingles
items.benefit: Purpose-made cap shingles cover the joints where roof planes meet, with a dimensional finish that complements the field shingles.
items.longevity: Helps defend exposed hips and ridges against leaks instead of leaving these joints as weak points.
items.selection: Confirm the cap profile, color, fastening and vent assembly for the selected roof. Field-shingle impact ratings do not automatically apply to ridge caps.
